）すると「参加中（さんかちゅう）」に変（か）わります。\n\n\n\n\n■バトル結果の確認\n毎日のバトルの結果は、「バトル結果一覧」から確認することができます。\n\n\n","release_at":"2024-05-23T01:50:45.238Z","imageURL":"None"},{"end_at":null,"priority":0,"title":"關於雲端對戰","platform":"all","content":"在雲端對戰中，可將自己的戰鬥陀螺編入隊伍，在雲端與其他陀螺鬥士配對，自動進行對戰。\n\n■對戰\n對戰期間為每週日23時至週六17時。\n每日5時、11時、17時、23時會自動進行對戰，總共進行24場對戰。\n參加後便會自動進行對戰至週六17時為止。\n\n■中途參加\n雲端對戰舉辦期間內可隨時參加。\n參加之後，會從預定的下一場對戰開始進行。\n\n■勝敗\n與其他玩家自動對戰，率先獲得4點的陀螺鬥士將會勝出。\n・極限勝利：3點\n・爆裂勝利：2點\n・擊飛勝利：2點\n・旋轉勝利：1點\n\n■勝敗場數\n雲端對戰結束後（週六17時的對戰結束後），將顯示對戰勝敗場數。\n可依照勝利場數獲得陀螺點數。\n\n■參加下一次雲端對戰\n雲端對戰結束後，若要參加下一次的雲端對戰，請再重新選擇參加。\n","imageURL":"None","invalid":false,"update_at":"2024-05-28T06:01:02.443Z","release_at":"2024-05-28T06:01:02.443Z","showType":"tutorial","id":"01HYYWPTRC96SREDC3YADAQMAP","isHiddenDate":false,"tutorialId":"home_cloud_match-ZhTW"},{"end_at":null,"title":"有關雲端對戰","priority":0,"content":"在雲端對戰，您可以使用自己的爆旋陀螺設置陀螺組合，在雲端與其他陀螺手配對並進行自動對戰。\n\n■對戰\n對戰期間為每週星期日23時至星期六17時。\n每日23時、5時、11時、17時進行自動對戰，總共進行24場比賽。\n一旦參加將自動進行對戰至星期六17時。\n\n■中途參加\n雲端對戰舉行期間您可以隨時參加。\n參加之後從下一場對戰開始。\n\n■勝負\n與其他玩家自動對戰，首先獲得4點數的陀螺手得勝。\n・極限勝利：3點數\n・擊爆勝利：2點數\n・衝擊勝利：2點數\n・持久勝利：1點數\n\n■勝負數\n雲端對戰結束後（星期六17時的對戰結束後），將顯示對戰的勝負數。\n根據獲勝場數，可獲得BEY點數。\n\n■參加下一輪雲端對戰\n雲端對戰結束後，如要參加下一輪雲端對戰，請再次報名參加。\n","platform":"all","imageURL":"None","update_at":"2024-05-28T06:03:03.962Z","invalid":false,"showType":"tutorial","release_at":"2024-05-28T06:03:03.962Z","id":"01HYYWRG4M2VP08SXEV7WS7CZE","isHiddenDate":false,"tutorialId":"home_cloud_match-ZhHK"},{"end_at":null,"title":"Cloud Matches","priority":0,"content":"In Cloud Matches, you add Beyblades you own to a deck and automatically battle other bladers you're matched against.\n\n■ Matches\nMatches take place every week from 23:00 Sunday to 17:00 Saturday.\nA total of 24 matches happen automatically at 05:00, 11:00, 17:00 and 23:00 daily.\nOnce you've taken part, you'll automatically participate in subsequent matches until 17:00 on Saturday.\n\n■ Joining partway\nYou can join Cloud Matches at any point while they are running.\nYou'll start from the next match to take place after you join.\n\n■ How to win\nYou battle against other players automatically, and the first blader to take 4 points wins.\n・ XTREME FINISH: 3 points\n・ BURST FINISH: 2 points\n・ OVER FINISH: 2 points\n・ SPIN FINISH: 1 point\n\n■ Results\nMatch results (numbers of victories and defeats) and shown once the Cloud Match finishes (after the 17:00 match on Saturdays).\nYou obtain Bey Points based on the number of matches you win.\n\n■ Participating in subsequent Cloud Matches\nIf you want to participate in the next Cloud Match once the current one has finished, you will need to join again.\n","platform":"all","imageURL":"None","invalid":false,"update_at":"2024-05-28T06:06:04.475Z","showType":"tutorial","release_at":"2024-05-28T06:06:04.475Z","id":"01HYYWXVSTCFBRSHMJHAJNPGJF","isHiddenDate":false,"tutorialId":"home_cloud_match-EnSG"},{"end_at":null,"title":"關於雲端對戰","priority":0,"content":"■參加雲端對戰的方法\n①改裝戰鬥陀螺\n自畫面右上方的「編輯隊伍」改裝戰鬥陀螺。\n\n\n\n・「選擇隊伍」畫面\n選擇要在雲端對戰使用的隊伍。\n觸碰「編輯隊伍」後將移動至「編輯隊伍」畫面。\n\n\n\n\n・「編輯隊伍」畫面\n編輯要在雲端對戰使用的隊伍。\n將3個戰鬥陀螺編入隊伍。\n可用上下箭頭變更戰鬥陀螺的順序。\n觸碰「進行改裝」後將移動至「選擇零件」畫面。\n\n\n\n・「選擇零件」畫面\n可選擇戰鬥陀螺的零件。\n最初會預先設置出借陀螺。可選擇的零件為已登錄至型錄的零件。\n可左右滑動來切換零件。\n觸碰「從一覽中選擇」即可自清單選擇零件。\n隊伍內的戰鬥陀螺之間不可使用相同種類的零件。\n\n\n\n\n②選擇隊伍\n戰鬥陀螺改裝結束後，要選擇用來參加雲端對戰的隊伍。\n在「選擇隊伍」畫面中，標示為「已選擇」的隊伍即為用來參加雲端對戰的隊伍。\n參加雲端對戰期間內可以更換隊伍。\n\n\n\n\n③參加雲端對戰\n畫面上會顯示已選擇的隊伍。\n若隊伍沒有問題，觸碰畫面下方的「參加」即可參加雲端對戰。\n\n\n\n\n參加雲端對戰後，畫面上將變為「正在參加」。\n\n\n\n\n■確認對戰結果\n可於「對戰結果一覽」確認每日的對戰結果。\n\n\n","platform":"all","imageURL":"None","update_at":"2024-05-28T06:07:47.177Z","invalid":false,"showType":"tutorial","release_at":"2024-05-28T06:07:47.177Z","id":"01HYYX0W7M1D3D7VCK8PYM58AN","isHiddenDate":false,"tutorialId":"home_cloud_match(page2)-ZhTW"},{"end_at":null,"title":"有關雲端對戰","priority":0,"content":"■雲端對戰的參加方法\n1 從自訂爆旋陀螺\n頁面右上方的「編輯陀螺組合」自訂爆旋陀螺\n\n\n\n・「選擇陀螺組合」頁面\n選擇在雲端對戰使用的陀螺組合。\n輕觸「編輯陀螺組合」將轉移至「編輯陀螺組合」頁面。\n\n\n\n\n・「編輯陀螺組合」頁面\n編輯在雲端對戰使用的陀螺組合。\n陀螺組合可設置3個爆旋陀螺。\n使用上下箭咀可更改爆旋陀螺的次序。\n輕觸「進行自訂」將轉移至「選擇部件」頁面。\n\n\n\n・「選擇部件」頁面\n您可以選擇爆旋陀螺的部件。\n起初設定為借用陀螺。可選擇的部件為登記於目錄的部件。\n向左右滑動可切換部件。\n輕觸「從一覽選擇」可從清單中選擇部件。\n無法於同一陀螺組合內使用同一部件。\n\n\n\n\n2 選擇陀螺組合\n完成自訂爆旋陀螺後，請選擇用於參加雲端對戰的陀螺組合。\n在「選擇陀螺組合」頁面，顯示「選擇中」的陀螺組合為參加雲端對戰的陀螺組合。\n您可於參加雲端對戰期間更改陀螺組合。\n\n\n\n\n3 參加雲端對戰\n選擇中的陀螺組合將顯示於頁面。\n如確認使用此陀螺組合，輕觸頁面下方的「參加」即可參加雲端對戰。\n\n\n\n\n參加雲端對戰時將變更為「參加中」。\n\n\n\n\n■對戰結果確認\n您可以從「對戰結果一覽」查看每日的對戰結果。\n\n\n","platform":"all","imageURL":"None","invalid":false,"update_at":"2024-05-28T06:08:30.709Z","showType":"tutorial","release_at":"2024-05-28T06:08:30.709Z","id":"01HYYX1XHE5RXJHNZMEXH3D2RK","isHiddenDate":false,"tutorialId":"home_cloud_match(page2)-ZhHK"},{"end_at":null,"title":"Cloud Matches","priority":0,"content":"■ How to participate in Cloud Matches\n① Customize your Beyblades\nCustomize your Beyblades via \"Deck Customization\" at the top-right of the screen.\n\n\n\n・ Deck Selection Screen\nHere you can select the deck to use for Cloud Matches.\nTap on \"Customize Deck\" to edit the deck.\n\n\n\n・ Deck Customization Screen\nHere you can select the deck to use for Cloud Matches.\nYou add three Beyblades to your deck.\nYou can change the order of your Beyblades using the up/down arrows.\nTap \"Customize\" to go to the Parts Selection Screen.\n\n\n\n・ Parts Selection Screen\nHere you can select your Beyblade parts.\nInitially, a Rental Bay will be in your deck. The parts you can select are those that appear (are registered) in the catalogue.\nYou can change parts by swiping left/right.\nAlternatively, tap on \"Select from List\" to choose parts from a list of available parts.\nYou can't reuse parts within a deck.\n\n\n\n\n② Select your deck\nOnce you've finished customizing your Beyblades, you need to pick a deck to use in the Cloud Match.\nThe deck marked \"Selected\" on the Deck Selection Screen is the one that will be used in Cloud Matches.\nYou can also change your deck while you are taking part in a Cloud Match.\n\n\n\n\n③ Join the Cloud Match\nThe currently selected deck will be shown on the screen.\nIf you're okay with this deck, tap \"Participate\" at the bottom of the screen to join the Cloud Match.\n\n\n\n\nThe status will change to \n\"Participating\" once you have joined a Cloud Match.\n\n\n\n\n■ Battle results confirmation\nYou can check out the daily battle results via \"Battle Results List\".\n\n\n","platform":"all","imageURL":"None","update_at":"2024-05-28T06:10:12.440Z","invalid":false,"showType":"tutorial","release_at":"2024-05-28T06:10:12.440Z","id":"01HYYX55M0P9RQ8P6B2H59XJAQ","isHiddenDate":false,"tutorialId":"home_cloud_match(page2)-EnSG"},{"end_at":null,"priority":0,"title":"雲端對戰","content":"已開始舉辦雲端對戰。參加雲端對戰來獲得陀螺點數吧！","platform":"all","imageURL":"None","update_at":"2024-05-28T06:17:33.848Z","invalid":false,"showType":"tutorial","release_at":"2024-05-28T06:17:33.848Z","id":"01HYYXJDPQNKS9G12X5R66FSCV","isHiddenDate":false,"tutorialId":"started_cloudmatch-ZhTW"},{"end_at":null,"priority":0,"title":"雲端對戰","content":"現正舉辦雲端對戰。參加雲端對戰獲取BEY點數吧！","platform":"all","imageURL":"None","invalid":false,"update_at":"2024-05-28T06:18:20.420Z","showType":"tutorial","release_at":"2024-05-28T06:18:20.420Z","id":"01HYYXKPNA8661VF3Y8BVJQNP0","isHiddenDate":false,"tutorialId":"started_cloudmatch-ZhHK"},{"end_at":null,"priority":0,"title":"Cloud Match","platform":"all","content":"There is a Cloud Match underway.
